decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt is a flagship extension of an established range and has stayed on the website for two years, so it fits the firm's biodynamic direction and costs little to keep on its existing yogurt lines, which makes dropping it unwarranted.
The mild sliced cheese was launched only in 2024, so its market value is still uncertain, and it uses in-house cheesemaking at low marginal cost, so keeping the option open is worthwhile.

The sliced butter cheese is a recent, low-cost variant on existing cheese capacity whose results have not yet shown it will fail, so it should be kept while demand information accumulates, though it may overlap with Product B.
